# Changelog

<!-- Generated by tools/release/Update-ReleaseMetadata.ps1; edit docs/release/NOTES.md. -->

## 1.0.1 (unreleased)

This patch repairs the portable distribution and refreshes the terminal while
preserving the established image/output pipeline and original-file safeguards.

## Compatibility repair

- No separate ImageMagick installation required for the portable ZIP. The package
  includes an authenticated upstream Windows x64 runtime, delegate notices and
  corresponding-source information. The dependency is upstream 7.1.2-35 Beta,
  selected for libheif 1.23.7 security fixes absent from 7.1.2-34 stable. Its upstream
  beta status is disclosed; this application patch uses its tested pinned bytes.
  Provenance pins the build-time asset and payload.
- All probes and image operations use one verified absolute app-relative engine.
  An older or absent system executable does not affect the portable ZIP. Missing
  or damaged packaged bytes fail before execution and request a fresh extraction.
- Private child search paths isolate modules/configuration/delegates. Explicit
  administrator/local policy denials remain effective; no alternate-engine retry.
- Inventory precedes engine startup. Empty runs are explicit no-ops and videos
  copy unchanged without an engine. Unsupported optional decoders remain per-file
  partial results so supported siblings complete.
- Source checkouts retain direct PowerShell use, compatible newer supported 7.x
  discovery, and the same developer staging command as release packaging.

## Terminal

- Original ASCII wordmark and numbered INPUT / ENGINE / PROCESS / RESULT sections,
  cyan/teal labels, amber warnings and red errors, with darker colours for light
  backgrounds and plain foreground labels when the palette is unavailable.
- Actual engine version/source, bounded progress, meaningful result counts and
  complete copyable Output, Report and Log paths. NO_COLOR and redirected/no RawUI
  hosts use plain lines. The BAT preserves the specific cause and exit 0/1/2/130.
- Interactive launcher sessions retain their pause; redirected automation finishes
  unattended. Logs and CSV retain their data semantics without terminal decoration.

## Preserved behavior

The default remains 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB), best effort. Orientation, sRGB conversion,
white alpha, metadata removal, first-frame/page selection, collision handling,
source preservation, byte-identical videos, cancellation, native deadlines and
validated single-frame JPEG output remain mandatory. Windows PowerShell 5.1 and
PowerShell 7 remain supported. The application processes locally and does not upload.

## Verification and limitations

Automated hotfix evidence records actual Windows OS/build, both shell hosts,
real old-PATH red-to-green reproduction, package integrity, codecs, policy denial,
console paths, original hashes and public-byte checks. No Windows 10 execution
is claimed. Hosted Windows Server results are reported as Windows Server results.
The application is unsigned; checksums identify bytes, not a verified publisher.

## Earlier release

Version 1.0.0 remains unchanged at its original tag and download. Its historical
acceptance and preparation-time documentation remain in Git history and the
original publication record. This patch replaces its external-engine distribution
requirement; it does not lower the security floor to the vulnerable old executable.
